# Adplat Admin MCP (v1.3.0)
> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Adplat.space & Dastyar advertising administration.

## Core Scope
Provides 120 production-ready tools for AI assistants (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor) to manage:
- Analytics & Deep Statistics: 22 reporting tools (capacity, sales trends, user insights, circulating funds, performance rankings)
- Ad Places & Platforms: 16 tools (creation, base price updates, daily overrides, occupancy calendar, booking blocks)
- Placement Content Architecture: 15 tools (creative fields, variants, templates, default items)
- Campaign Deep Operations: 22 tools (full edit, manual status override, budget injection, bookings bulk edit, creative revisions, short links)
- Search Clusters & SERP: 9 tools (keyword clusters, placement variants, search inventory)
- Automations Engine: 6 tools (SMS triggers, delivery modes, scheduled jobs, test SMS)
- Integration API Keys: 3 tools (generate, list, revoke platform API keys)
- Users & Wallets: 5 tools (profile dossiers, manual wallet top-up, deduction, legal invoices)
- Billing & Payments: 3 tools (bank receipts review, approvals)
- Support Tickets: 3 tools (conversations, attachments, replies)
- Industries Taxonomy: 4 tools (business categories CRUD)
- System Notifications: 2 tools (alerts, mark read)
- Media Uploads: 3 tools (direct CDN upload, presigned S3 URLs)
- Authentication: 7 tools (Browser 1-click loopback, SMS OTP, Permanent API key, password login)

## Authentication Protocol
Zero password storage in MCP config required.
1. Browser Loopback (Recommended): `npm run login` -> http://localhost:43210 auto-detects browser session in 1 second.
2. Headless SMS OTP: `adplat_auth_send_otp` -> `adplat_auth_verify_otp`.
3. Permanent API Key: `adplat_auth_set_api_key`.
